original_test_intent: Verify OAM_0 power consumption is valid and consistently represented by SMC Redfish, IPMI, ROCm and BMC Web.
original_method: Map the physical OAM_0 power metric on all interfaces, identify whether each value is instantaneous or averaged and what rails/components it includes, capture within an approved window, normalize watts and compare using defined limits and tolerance.
manual_activity: Power/GPU owner approves the OAM_0 measurement domain and tolerance, confirms Web mapping and judges discrepancies.
required_inputs: OAM_0 identity and power metric crosswalk
Per-source rail/component boundary and averaging window
Watts conversion, valid range, delta and age/skew limits
Stable idle or specified load condition
Secure BMC/DUT tools and Web access
safety_requirements: Do not create load in this telemetry check unless separately approved
Stop on negative, stale, unavailable, out-of-range or semantically unmatched metrics
agent_execution_scope: Collect all required OAM_0 power views
Document metric boundary/window and capture context
Report anomalies without changing power state or verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its Redfish Power read is relevant but insecure and insufficient because source-required IPMI/ROCm/Web metrics may have different boundaries or windows.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Under a stable approved operating point, securely capture mapped OAM_0 power from every interface with timestamps and aggregation semantics, then compare normalized watts.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OAM_0, all named observation planes and 5/5-minute read-only scope are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a four-source table containing physical boundary, instantaneous/average window, raw value/unit, sample time/age, normalized watts and tolerance result.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Prevents semantically different power numbers from being judged by literal equality.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Does not validate meter calibration or power under stress unless separately specified.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Software surfaces may intentionally report different rail domains; only approved equivalent metrics should be compared numerically.

project_override_considerations: Engineering defines whether each OAM_0 surface reports ASIC, module or rail power and which averaging windows are comparable.
expected_evidence: OAM_0 identity and approved power crosswalk
Logs, anomaly disposition, cleanup and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently requests OAM_0 power comparison; DeepSeek is an incomplete insecure implementation rather than a conflicting requirement.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Metric definitions, secure access and confirmation are normal supplyable prerequisites.

review_improvement: Adds power-domain and averaging-window semantics so unlike OAM_0 metrics are not falsely compared as identical measurements.
independent_technical_reasoning: Redfish may expose module input power, ROCm ASIC power and IPMI a board rail average; all can legitimately be labeled watts yet measure different boundaries. Their averaging windows and capture times also affect deltas under changing load. Meaningful parity therefore starts with an approved domain/window crosswalk and stable operating context, not literal equality of one sample.
